title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
evidence_summary: Reports Top-20/Top-100 passage accuracy, end-to-end QA exact match, query throughput, index construction cost, and retriever training ablations.
unresolved_gap: The paper evaluates single-hop answer-containing passage retrieval; bridge and complete-chain recall are outside its stated task and should not be inferred.

title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
evidence_summary: Reports MRR@10, Recall@50/200/1000, reranking and end-to-end retrieval latency, FLOPs, and ablations; reranking uses the fixed official BM25 top-1000 pool.
unresolved_gap: No downstream QA or multi-hop support-chain evaluation is provided because the central claim is general passage ranking.

title: Answering Complex Open-Domain Questions with Multi-Hop Dense Retrieval
evidence_summary: Reports Support Passage Exact Match, answer recall, R@2/10/20, downstream results, and retriever ablations including order, shared encoder, memory bank, and single-hop variants.
unresolved_gap: The fixed two-hop path is measured at the sequence level, but per-instance recovery, stopping, and released query/action traces are not evaluated; the 10x efficiency comparison is partly estimated for baselines.

title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
source_locator: PDF pp. 3–6; Fig. 2; Figs. 3–4; Secs. 3.1–4.3; Appendix C
evidence_summary: Defines explicit alternating reason/retrieve steps, stops on an answer marker or after eight steps, caps collected paragraphs at 15, and reports fixed-budget retrieval recall, answer F1, OOD tests, and manual factual-error analysis.
unresolved_gap: Aggregate diagnostics for invalid queries, recovery after a bad step, premature stopping, wall-clock latency, and monetary cost are not reported.

title: LLMLingua: Compressing Prompts for Accelerated Inference of Large Language Models
evidence_summary: Reports compression ratios, token counts, task performance across reasoning and generation datasets, component ablations, compressor overhead, and 1.7x–5.7x end-to-end speedups.
unresolved_gap: Preservation is inferred mainly from downstream performance; relation-level support, provenance retention, and evidence-removal interventions are not directly measured.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
claim_focus: position sensitivity in long-context evidence use
evidence_summary: Holds the relevant document and distractor set controlled while varying context length and evidence position; reports multi-document QA and key-value retrieval accuracy and identifies a U-shaped position effect.
unresolved_gap: The study isolates context use rather than proposing a retrieval or integration method; it does not measure multi-hop relation preservation or claim-level grounding.

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
claim_focus: verbal feedback and episodic memory across retries
source_locator: PDF pp. 3–6; Fig. 2; Fig. 4; Secs. 3–4.3; Appendix D.4
evidence_summary: Stores textual reflections in episodic memory, reports learning curves across repeated trials on ALFWorld, HotpotQA, and code tasks, and includes episodic-memory and self-reflection ablations.
unresolved_gap: Most improvement is measured through retries on the same task instances; held-out cross-task transfer, negative transfer, forgetting, and matched context-cost controls are not established.

title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
source_locator: PDF pp. 2–9, 35; Fig. 1; Tables 1–3 and 6; Secs. 4–5.6
evidence_summary: Collects success/failure trajectories from training tasks, extracts reusable insights, retrieves similar successful trajectories for unseen evaluation tasks, reports same-distribution gains, HotpotQA-to-FEVER forward transfer, and component ablations.
unresolved_gap: Negative transfer, forgetting, stale-memory behavior, and long-horizon library growth are not evaluated; transfer is demonstrated in one source-to-target pairing.
